violations.message: Has its own copy of the snapshot-storage rule (doc comment, Map-of-snapshots, clone-on-save, restore-on-read) instead of sharing one module abstraction with InMemoryProductRepository. That duplication is why the two repositories have drifted apart.

save() stores product.toSnapshot() without the structuredClone that InMemoryOrderRepository uses. The module's shared snapshot-isolation rule ('changes only become visible once ... saved') is copied into each file and applied differently, so nested snapshot state may stay shared with the live Product.
